name: mainline_source_observed_ranking_v1
objective: Compare frozen role/native decision inputs on identical source-only observed histories, without selecting a target-specific correction or claiming certification.
source_fit: Reuse existing whole-policy48train/16held partition and unchanged fit recipes separately for each of3frozen source archives. All rawreplicates of held policies excluded from every response-dependent fit. Do not overwrite deployment bundles.
fixed_history: For each source archive/fold/source family, use first raw pair at held policy IDs0..12 in fixed partition order: initial10 then3updates. All arms observe the same physical policies/raw order; no adaptive query selection. Freeze predictions at prefixes10and13, observed-only terminal ranks at13, and predictions for held IDs13..15 never observed.
ranking: Unchanged terminal probability-of-violation<=0.5 eligibility, objective-mean rank and minimum-violation fallback. Compare eligible sets, relative-objective ranks and ordering changes; record no-eligible cases. No new selector, threshold, temperature or ensemble weight.
scoring: Freeze all available forecasts before held scoring labels. For observed13 use remaining two raw repeats only; never-observed3 use allthree. Report f/g mean error, relative-objective ordering and predictive-noise agreement against noisy held labels. These are not true chance-feasibility or80/128certificate labels. Keep uncertainty and missing results.
statistical_unit: Report each source-archive/fold/source-family case and family summaries. Source families and archives overlap;24fold-family cases are not24independent tasks. This d50 source-policy holdout does not establish d1000 task generalization.
target_exclusion: No Stage56/earlier target outcomes enter fitting, scoring, threshold selection or source case ordering. Positive and negative target cases motivate the comparison only.
failure: Keep fit failures, original precision/ESS flags and paid CPU; no retries with changed precision, discarded folds or invented predictions.
decision: Retain current deployment model and AFTER working baseline. Initial propagation improves unobserved mean prediction, but continued propagation worsens two empirical terminal decisions and includes a boundary noise distortion. No uniform risk, noise or native-terminal replacement is adopted.
operator_requirements: Parameterize fit_native with each archive heldout_target_family; its existing FactorShock literal is not valid for the other two source archives.

Use actual native initial10 fitting, task-pilot and HVD update path, then the same3fixed raw updates. Its pilot may access only the allowed initial10 raw pairs, not scoring repeats or held policies13..15. build_source_engine alone is only a role projection stub with gpr[0]=None and is not a native posterior.
AFTER uses the deployed mainline_role_after_init initial10 boundary and point-local later updates; do not use the old point_after_first two-anchor shortcut.
Source-fit held-policy exclusion precedes fitting; allowed first-raw history adaptation is a separate declared use. Future independent scoring uses only unused repeats.

execution_preparation.smoke: First registered archive/fold is the full-path smoke and retained as formal output; no held scoring until all12 fold files are frozen.
